LanguageData.VanillaIce_DesignatorIceHarvestZoneDesc: Designate an area where colonists will harvest ice blocks.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandAllowHarvestIceDesc: Enables or disables ice harvesting in this zone.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvestIce_NoHarvestabl: No harvestable ice remains in this zone.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvestIce_StockLimitRe: Ice harvesting is paused. Current map stock: {0}. Harvesting pauses at {1} and resumes at {2}.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvestSnow_NoHarvestab: No harvestable snow remains in this zone.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvestSnow_StockLimitR: Snow harvesting is paused. Current map stock: {0}. Harvesting pauses at {1} and resumes at {2}.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvest_NoReachableCell: No reachable harvest cell is available in this zone.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CannotHarvest_NotOnMap: Selected pawn is not on this map.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_StockLimitActive: Stock target active. Current: {0}. Pause at {1}, resume at {2}.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_StockLimitPaused: Stock target reached. Current: {0}. Harvesting resumes at {2}.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandMaintainStockTargetDes: Open stock target settings for this resource on the current map.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_StockTargetConfigDescription: Applies map-wide to all harvest zones of this resource on the current map.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_StockTargetEnabledDesc: Pause harvesting when the map stock reaches the pause threshold, then resume once it falls back to the resume threshold.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandPauseHarvestAtDesc: Set the map-wide stock count where harvesting pauses.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandResumeHarvestAtDesc: Set the map-wide stock count where harvesting resumes after pausing.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandPauseHarvestAtDialog: Pause harvesting when map stock reaches: {0} Harvesting resumes at: {1}
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandResumeHarvestAtDialog: Resume harvesting when map stock falls to: {0} Harvesting pauses at: {1}
LanguageData.VanillaIce_Settings_BlocksPerHarvest: Blocks per harvest action: {0} Base number of ice blocks yielded per harvest. Mining Yield stat applies.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_Settings_ColdEnergyPerBlock: Cooling power per block: {0} GEU Energy absorbed per ice block. At 200 GEU, 1 full stack lasts 2 to 4 days.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_DesignatorSnowHarvestZoneDesc: Designate an area where colonists will harvest snow into snowballs.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_CommandAllowHarvestSnowDesc: Enables or disables snow harvesting in this zone.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_Settings_SnowballsPerHarvest: Snowballs per harvest action: {0} Base number of snowballs yielded per harvest. Mining Yield stat applies.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_Settings_SnowballColdEnergy: Cooling power per snowball: {0} GEU Energy absorbed per snowball. At 100 GEU, 1 full stack lasts 1 to 2 days.
LanguageData.VanillaIce_Settings_CaravanMeltRate: Ice melt in caravans tuning at 25 C: ~{0} full stacks per day At 0.25, a full 75-stack of ice blocks or snowballs melts by about one quarter per day at 25 C. Smaller stacks melt proportionally faster.
